_readme: Configured by SETUP.md ('Set up versioning'). Used by bump-version.ps1.
Patterns are .NET regexes; each MUST contain a (?<ver>...) named group ((?<num>...) for buildNumber) and MUST match its file exactly once — the script aborts otherwise (drift protection).
Paths are relative to this file (repo root).
Doc 'Updated:' dates are NOT touched by the script — keeping those current is part of normal doc upkeep.
